detect_language_from_path extracts extension from nested path src/main.rs

```go title="Go"

import (
	"fmt"
	tspack "github.com/xberg-io/tree-sitter-language-pack/packages/go"
)

func main() {
	result := tspack.DetectLanguageFromPath(`src/main.rs`)

}
```
